fact: The Persons with Disability Advisory Council launched a Disability Mainstreaming Assessment Report of the social development ministry under Section 6 of the Persons with Disability Equity Act 2021, which mandates it to assess disability inclusion and the accessibility of services in public institutions.
title: PWDAC COMMENDED THE GOVERNMENT FOR INCLUSION OF DISABILITY IN POLICIES, STRUCTURES AND BUDGETING
publisher: Lesotho News Agency (via Government of Lesotho)
